# Plain Metal's generateMipmapsForTexture: on an Apple M3 Max (macOS 26.7, 25G229): the format
# chains of share-mips-m3b (our own probe). 21 formats at 256x256, 193x193, 300x200, 130x130,
# 1024x16 and as a 128x128 cube, Private with allowGPUOptimizedContents off (plain); RGBA16Float
# Private at 257 to 1025 (three seeds), 2048x2048, and 32x32 and 64x64 (eight seeds); R16Float and
# RG16Float Private at 1024x1024; and a 2048x16 BGRA8Unorm chain, plain. The first levels come from
# measured_m3_passes.txt's probe, keyed by the chain's key (seed tags included). Each level's digest
# is the first 12 hex digits of the SHA-256 of its bytes, every layer in turn, rows tight.
# Format:
#   <key> <format> <2d|2darray|cube> <width>x<height> <layers> <pattern> <private|plain>
#   <digest of level 0> ...
